en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large, rectangular barracks building along a wide, unpaved tree‑lined street. The multi‑story structure has a hipped roof and many regular windows, with an ornate metal gate and a few uniformed soldiers in front. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Red printed text at the top identifies the scene, and vertical text appears along the left edge.
